vGPU.label: vGPU (Virtual GPU)
vGPU.description: Enable or disable GPU virtualization sharing. When enabled, the sandbox can share the host's GPU for hardware acceleration.
vGPU.detailedInfo: Enables or disables GPU sharing with the sandbox. This allows graphics-intensive applications to run more smoothly by leveraging the host's GPU.

Networking.label: Networking
Networking.description: Control network access for the sandbox. When disabled, the sandbox will have no network connectivity.
Networking.detailedInfo: Controls whether the sandbox has network access. Disabling networking provides additional isolation but prevents internet-based operations.

AudioInput.label: Audio Input
AudioInput.description: Control whether the sandbox can access the host's microphone.
AudioInput.detailedInfo: Enables or disables audio input sharing with the sandbox. When enabled, applications in the sandbox can access your microphone.

VideoInput.label: Video Input
VideoInput.description: Control whether the sandbox can access the host's camera.
VideoInput.detailedInfo: Enables or disables video input sharing with the sandbox. When enabled, applications in the sandbox can access your webcam.

ProtectedClient.label: Protected Client
ProtectedClient.description: Adds additional security hardening to the sandbox. When enabled, provides extra isolation for sensitive operations.
ProtectedClient.detailedInfo: Increases security by adding extra layers of protection. Recommended for handling untrusted content or running potentially malicious software.

PrinterRedirection.label: Printer Redirection
PrinterRedirection.description: Control whether the sandbox can access the host's printers.
PrinterRedirection.detailedInfo: Enables or disables printer sharing with the sandbox. When enabled, you can print from applications running in the sandbox.

ClipboardRedirection.label: Clipboard Redirection
ClipboardRedirection.description: Control clipboard sharing between the sandbox and the host.
ClipboardRedirection.detailedInfo: Enables or disables clipboard sharing. When enabled, you can copy and paste content between the host and the sandbox.

MemoryInMB.label: Memory (MB)
MemoryInMB.description: Amount of memory to allocate to the sandbox in megabytes.
MemoryInMB.detailedInfo: Specifies the amount of memory (in MB) to assign to the sandbox. Must be sufficient to boot Windows. If not specified, the sandbox uses a default based on available host memory.
